posts.title: OS 101: What is an Operating System?
posts.description: What Is an Operating System The problem it exists to solve Not "it manages resources" — that describes what an OS does, not why it must exist. posts.title: Setting up AuthN/AuthZ with Keycloak (OpenID Connect) for a REST Go API
posts.description: Most Go services eventually need to answer two questions about every request: who is calling? and are they allowed to do this? The first is authentication, the second is authorization, and it's tempting to hand-roll both with a users table and a middleware that checks a session cookie.
